name: Gaussian-JEPA Pretraining
aliases: Gaussian-JEPA Pretraining — Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats
Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats
definition: A self-supervised pretraining method for 3D Gaussian assets that predicts latent features of masked target blocks from shared context features, using complementary geometric and appearance latent spaces and feature-space grounding objectives.
summary: Gaussian-JEPA is a self-supervised pretraining method for 3D Gaussian assets that predicts latent features of masked blocks from context, distinguishing itself by avoiding raw-attribute reconstruction.
